findings.claim: The egress table leaves Docker's embedded DNS alone (deploy/egress.py), so a container's name lookups still reach the hospital's resolver (review 16's J-M7); the decision waits on card 10G-49
The vendor's update key is one file passed as --key to tools/make_bundle.sh: one person can sign a release (card 10G-7)

The audit signing key sits in the box's own secrets folder (tools/trialbox/audit_heads.py): root can change the events written since the last signed head before the next night signs them, and holds the key that signs (review 16, section 2.2; card 10G-2)
